description: This file defines a Java class DefaultExceptionHandler, which implements a custom uncaught exception handler for Java threads. It captures unhandled exceptions, logs them, and displays an error dialog to the user.

classes.name: DefaultExceptionHandler
classes.description: A custom implementation of UncaughtExceptionHandler that logs exceptions, displays a dialog, and prevents multiple exception handling.

methods.name: uncaughtException
methods.description: Handles exceptions that are not caught in thread execution by delegating to handleException.

methods.name: handleException
methods.description: Logs the exception, displays a dialog with the stack trace, and ensures only one exception is handled at a time.

methods.name: findActiveFrame
methods.description: Finds and returns the currently visible JFrame to use as parent for dialogs.
